title: flags.json
description: Tide's feature flags. Each flag is declared once with its default, which is always off: unfinished or unapproved work merges switched off, and Jordan's yes turns it on (a decision.answered event, then flag.set).

default.description: Always false: a flag is off until a decision turns it on.

what.description: What turning it on changes, in plain words.

lane.description: The upgrade lane that owns the switched code.
